title: Model Provider Dossier & Procurement Readiness Scorecard
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Create a standardized dossier and quantitative scorecard for model providers (open-source distributions, cloud-hosted vendors, and boutique inference services) to support enterprise procurement conversations. The output will synthesize technical compatibility, cost/latency economics, legal/licensing risk, and operational readiness so sales and procurement can make defensible recommendations and SRE/Infra can plan integrations.
background: We frequently get ad-hoc asks from BD and Sales to compare providers for enterprise deals (dedicated vs hosted, quantized vs full FP16, on-prem feasibility). Current comparisons are slide-based and inconsistent. This work will reduce friction by producing a repeatable, versioned artifact (dossier + scorecard) and a short runbook for how to update it with new model variants or regional capacity signals.
deliverables: Provider dossier template (Confluence) with sections for tech, ops, legal, and economics
Procurement Readiness Scorecard spreadsheet with weighted metrics and guidance for thresholding (green/amber/red)
One-pager explainers for sales and SRE teams
Initial dossiers for 6 prioritized providers and one fallback simulation
acceptance_criteria: Template stored in Confluence and approved by Legal and Infra leads
Scorecard populated with initial data for 6 providers and peer-reviewed by Research
Runbook published describing data sources and cadence for updates
Hand-off session scheduled with Sales ops and Procurement with feedback captured
tasks: Draft dossier template and metric definitions
Runbench: small-context latency and token-cost sim for each provider
Interview Infra and SRE for integration constraints (VPC, KMS, on-prem install)
Coordinate legal for license classification and export controls assessment
Populate scorecard with quantitative and qualitative signals
Peer review and iterate with Research/Engineering/Legal
Publish and communicate to GTM and Procurement
